## Context
- Epic 78f2-b104-e3c9-4b86 requires promoting review `scanner-integration` from advisory to voting within the Gerrit `Verified` aggregate.
- Incident 90c7 showed two failure classes to avoid: a vacuous Verified vote where a newly-required job did not run on its own introducing change, followed by a portability defect that made the lane red for every downstream change.
- Promotion is safe now because the advisory lane is landed and validated green on real GHA (story aa9e-3d35-fd3e-41ee, CL 2666, merge SHA 4c9940348148fb255b17ddf1cb124701ad4565d7, run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33985796177), and b973-b298-9b5d-4765 closed the vacuous-vote escape with a predates-gate guard and lane-derived parity coverage.

## Scope
- Add a concrete `scanner-integration` job inside `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`, gated to the full route with the same `if:` shape as build-and-test/optionality, calling `./.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml` with the Gerrit refspec/project/url so it actually runs on the patchset.
- Add `scanner-integration` to `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` voting needs, vote normalization, and required workflow-conclusion aggregation so scanner failure blocks Verified.
- Reverse ADR-0114 advisory state in `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` and `docs/adr/0114-advisory-gate-before-hot-path.md`, so mirror-vs-Verified parity requires scanner-integration in the voting aggregate.
- Keep real mirror surfaces coherent: `.github/workflows/test.yml`, `.github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml`, and reusable `_scanner-integration.yml`. Jenkinsfile is a negative-control inspection only: it is reconcile-bridge-only and will not be edited for this scanner gate unless investigation proves otherwise, in which case this ticket stops for scope revision.
- Update direct string/symbol coverage inventory: `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py`, `tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py`, `tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`, and `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py`.

## Anti-90c7 safety design
- Non-vacuous proof: add `scanner-integration` coverage to `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` and the lane-derived parity tests, then before submit record the promoting change's own Gerrit Verified run URL/job showing `scanner-integration` executed and passed (not skipped).
- Back-out: if the promoted lane goes red on main, revert this CL to restore the ADR-0114 advisory exception and remove scanner-integration from voting needs, immediately unblocking downstream Verified.
- Portability and route safety: do not introduce bash-only shell options or a GitHub-only mechanism. Preserve POSIX-dash-safe Make recipes and mirrored GHA workflow semantics under parity tests. Thread scanner-integration through BOTH route arms: full route requires `needs.scanner-integration.result == 'success'`; docs-only route requires `needs.scanner-integration.result == 'skipped'`, preventing prose-only changes from failing because the full-route scanner did not run.

## Testing
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py` proves vote routing, both normalize route arms, workflow naming, parity, newly-added scanner predates coverage, and reversed advisory assertions.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` proves scanner-integration is required by voting parity.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint` proves formatting, ruff, module-size, complexity, mechanism-delta, and workflow parity gates.
- `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck` proves static typing remains green.
- Sandboxed mutation removes `scanner-integration` from the voting aggregate and confirms the held-out parity/predates oracle fails, then restores.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` proves a `scanner-integration` job exists inside `gerrit-verify.yaml`, calls `_scanner-integration.yml` with Gerrit patchset inputs, and executes automatically on the full Gerrit Verified route rather than only by manual dispatch.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py` proves `gerrit-verify.yaml` includes `scanner-integration` in voting needs, full-route success normalization, docs-only skipped normalization, and required workflow-conclusion aggregation; a scanner failure blocks Verified.
- [x] `python scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` and `pytest tests/unit/test_verify_gate_parity.py` pass only when `scanner-integration` is required in the voting aggregate and removed from ADR-0114 advisory exceptions.
- [x] Newly-added assertions in `pytest tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py` prove predates-gate/parity coverage includes `scanner-integration` and prevents a vacuous vote where the new job did not execute on its own introducing change.
- [x] `pytest tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` proves GHA/mirror scanner workflow coherence, advisory assertion reversal, and POSIX portability without relying on Jenkinsfile.
- [x] `make lint && make typecheck` plus targeted pytest above pass locally with `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
- [x] [non-codebase] Gerrit evidence recorded in a ticket comment includes change id, `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, run URL/job id, timestamp, and a non-skipped `scanner-integration` job that passed on this promoting change before submit.
  provenance: environment=GitHub Actions run 34009347945 for Gerrit CL 2682 patchset 2; principal=rebar CI bot + rebar review bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Gerrit dispatched the production Verified workflow against the exact promoting patchset and the live job record shows scanner-integration job 101422522565 completed successfully before submit.
